identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study of Repeat-Dose Subcutaneous Darbepoetin Alfa in Subjects With Congestive Heart Failure and Anemia, and a Single Dose in Healthy Age- and Sex-Matched Control Subjects
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Study to Assess the Pharmacokinetics and Pharmacodynamics of Repeat-Sose Subcutaneous Darbepoetin Alfa in Subjects With Congestive Heart Failure and Anemia, and a Single Dose in Healthy Age- and Sex-Matched Control Subjects

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the single dose pharmacokinetics (PK) of subcutaneous (SC) darbepoetin alfa in subjects with congestive heart failure (CHF) and anemia.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Pharmacokinetic profiling of Aranesp® in HF pts

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Pharmacodynamic responses (hgb) following Aranesp® administration in HF patients

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria: Inclusion Criteria: - Symptomatic CHF despite optimized therapy for at least the previous 3 months (treatment included a diuretic, angiotensin converting enzyme \[ACE\] inhibitor, and/or an A2 antagonist, unless not tolerated) - Hemoglobin greater than or equal to 12.5 g/dL at the time of screening
